name: print-social-purple-education-template-set
title: Purple gradient education post templates with pill labels
whatItIs: A set of six post templates for educators in a purple gradient palette: photos cropped in rounded frames, bold sans titles, capsule labels for dates and times, and quote bubbles. A banner notes 'Easy to edit'.
whatItMeans: Friendly and structured; gradients and pills make information cards feel digital and approachable.
techniques: Use a purple gradient across all posts as the system colour.
Turn date and time into stacked white capsules.
Crop photos into rounded frames or arches.
Place a quote bubble as a graphic accent.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded pill containing brief info.
One gradient reused across a set.
A photo crop with soft corners.
A layout built to be changed with new content.
